parameters.description_en:

parameters.description_en: The order ID. This parameter is required in practice. Encrypt the order ID before submission because it is reported to the regulatory platform.
parameters.description_zh: 订单 ID(实际上必填， 建议客户进行订单号加密，用于报送监管平台)。

parameters.name: order_id

parameters.description_en: Optional. The Industrial Internet identifier code, which has a one-to-one relationship with OrderId. The code supports delimiter characters such as "." and "/" to separate code segments. The code must not contain nonprinting characters such as spaces or line feeds. This parameter is required when the service user generates the Industrial Internet identifier code independently.
parameters.description_zh:
可选	工业互联网标识编码，与OrderID保持一一对应关系。编码支持“.”、“/”等字符分割编码域，编码中不得含有不可显示类字符，如空格符、换行符等。
当业务使用方自行生成工业互联网标识编码时，该字段必选。
